Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 16
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted a spurious “8 April 1924” birth year from the Charles Saunders (director) Wikipedia page without sanity-checking the internal inconsistency on that same page (it listed age at death as 93, which matches 1904, not 1924) and without reconciling it with other sources (TMDb and the Wikipedia snippet both indicating 1904). This misread/mis-triaged datum would lead to the wrong conclusion (favoring Love in Pawn) when the correct comparison shows Fernando Fernán Gómez (1921) was born later than Charles Saunders (1904), so El Extraño Viaje is the correct answer.
